rationale: Release, signing and deploy workflows (release-cli build-cli, sign-and-release, wclap-cloudflare) now compile with ccache disabled and re-fetch every FetchContent dependency into a fresh job-local root instead of reading host caches that PR jobs can write; choc, the Skia wasm slice and wasi-sdk land in RUNNER_TEMP, choc at an exact commit and Skia verified against its manifest digest, and format-baseline-diff pins AudioUnitSDK-1.3.0. This changes only which build inputs these jobs trust, not what they build or package; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
